what: Adversarial eval v3 after the second round of fixes of 19 Nov: the same 100 invoice cases (src/evals/adversarialV3Cases.ts, committed alone before any run, unchanged), on today's code (since the third round of 19 Nov, against v4's misses, with it too). Offline, test data only.
line: 100 adversarial and clean invoices, a script that always says pay in the model's place: 0 wrong payments with Purser's rules (0 that had to be held, 0 past the CFO), 74 with no rules; false holds 0 of 46 clean truths (fields from Purser's parser: 0 wrong payments, 0 false holds).
